name: morphosource
description: This is a simple package file to help developers periodically install or update the Universal Viewer packaged with MorphoSource. It is not part of regular install or setup processes.

scripts.postinstall: yarn run uv-build && yarn run uv-deploy && yarn run uv-config && rm -rf ./node_modules/
scripts.uv-build: cd ./node_modules/universalviewer && npm install && npm run build && cd ../..
